summary: A controlled, actor-friendly waiting beat with a clear progression: accounting, equipment checks, nervous humor, then the delayed signal. The dialogue is concise, period-appropriate and differentiated by rank and temperament; the sealed envelope gives the final report dramatic weight without exposition.

performance.delivery: Ask Mahmoud for confirmation, not information you have forgotten. Keep the voice controlled; the pressure is carried in the brief pause before his name.

lines.speaker: MAHMOUD

performance.delivery: Read directly from the notebook to Shalabi. Land clearly on the total and attached elements, with no flourish or uncertainty.

lines.text: مية واتنين وعشرين يَا فَنْدِمْ… بِفَصِيلْةِ الْمَالُوتْكَا وِالْمُهَنْدِسِينْ.

lines.speaker: SAYED

performance.delivery: Project along the resting row while continuing to inspect the men. Bite off «مِشْ هُنَاكْ» as a warning born from concern, not swagger.

lines.text: أَرْبَعْ خَزَايِنْ لِكُلّْ وَاحِدْ. اللِّي نَاقْصُهْ حَاجَةْ يِقُولْ دِلْوَقْتِي… مِشْ هُنَاكْ.

lines.speaker: ADEL

performance.delivery: Keep looking at the wire as though the question is casual. Let the final «فِينْ؟» reveal that Adel genuinely needs the answer.

lines.text: يَا شَاوِيشْ حَسَنْ… السِّلْكْ دَهْ لَوْ اتْقَطَعْ، الصَّارُوخْ يِرُوحْ فِينْ؟

lines.speaker: HASSAN

performance.delivery: Do not look up from the reel. State «يِرُوحْ أَعْمَى» as a plain fact, then give the instruction with quiet confidence.

lines.text: يِرُوحْ أَعْمَى… عَشَانْ كِدَهْ ثَبِّتْ إِيدَكْ.

performance.delivery: Lower the headset before reporting to Shalabi. Keep the apology implicit, as if a more careful operator might somehow have produced the signal.
